name: Witch Doctor Shadow Effigy slows every enemy within 30 yd
contract: Shadow Effigy 505339 summons creature 50119; the tooltip says enemies within $504761a1 yds (504761
EffectRadiusIndex 10 = 30 yd) have their casting speed reduced by 20% and movement speed by 40%. The effigy
AI applies Shadow Effigy 504761 (casting speed) and 504909 (casting and movement speed) to every valid enemy
that Nearby() returns (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:530-540). Two blocks (cycle 9 author D): the scan was
Nearby(me, 10.0f), and 504761 carries SPELL_ATTR5_LIMIT_N (AttributesEx5 1576 = 0x628), so a second enemy
given 504761 removed it from the first (Unit::_AddAura, single-cast auras of the doctor); a trial build with
the 30 yd scan alone left the dummy 29.78 yd out without 504761 (cycle 8, 20261121-020314). The fix scans
Radius(ShadowField) and clears LIMIT_N on 504761, whose own target is rewritten to one enemy per cast
(AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:523-538). Layout along +x from the doctor; the effigy stands 1.5 yd
from the doctor at 1.6 rad from the facing (Summon, Summons.cpp:202-206), so its distances are read too.
Edges from the effigy with both object sizes (IsWithinDistInMap; effigy 1.0, dummy 1.275): 12.275 yd before
the fix, 32.275 yd after. Primary 5 yd (affected in both builds), inside 20 yd (affected only after the
fix), outside 45 yd (never). Reads at one instant 3100 ms after the instant cast: the effigy pulses at once
and every 1000 ms and renews each aura for 2200 ms, so three pulses have run.

CONTROL: the outside dummy carries no 504909
